name: The Human Reignition Project
source:
In the near future, mankind remains much the same as it is in the modern day. There are no flying cars. There are no robots; no incredible new world order. However, as is natural with the passage of time, society has changed. Technology and modern conveniences  have become so widespread and accessible that just about anyone can easily fill their lives with luxurious simplicity. As a result, the general workings of modern life have changed. Many formerly busy systems and occupations have become obsolete or entirely digital. In drastic contrast with the size and population of cities, birth rates have long since hit a plateau and continue to drop slowly. In a general sense, the modern world is slowly dying. 

One man, a relic of an older time, forms a small group that seeks to change that.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20141217232256/http://reignitionproject.com/]Official site[/url]]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/the-human-reignition-project-an-english-visual-nov]Kickstarter page[/url]
translation:
近未来，人类与现代社会大体相同：没有飞行汽车，没有机器人，也没有奇异新世界秩序。然而随着时间流逝，社会发生变化。科技与现代便利设施普及，人们轻易用奢华简单填满生活，现代生活的运作方式随之改变。许多曾经忙碌的系统与职业已过时或完全数字化。与城市规模及人口形成鲜明对比的是，出生率早已达到平台期，仍在缓慢下降。总体而言，现代世界正在慢慢死去。

一名来自旧时代的男人组成了一个小团体，试图改变这一切。
